_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: 50 + 1.0 x (period - 1) - 2.0 x intervention + ward effect (SD 2) + noise (SD 8)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same effect, standard error, interval and variance components
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: below 1e-6. harness/clustered_examples.test.py fits the model with an independent REML in numpy (profiling the variance ratio) and checks both against it, and shows the model without period effects gives +1.22 against -1.56.

recovery.claim: the effect and both SDs are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: With 12 wards the ward SD is estimated loosely: its tolerance (1.8) cannot tell 2 from nearly 0, so that key is a weak check. At 20 patients per ward-period the effect's miss (1.74) was close to the effect; the fixture uses 50.
